scope: Synthetic embedding fixture; measures retrieval plumbing, not production embedding quality.

documents.title: EADDRINUSE socket conflict
documents.rootCause: A second process occupies the configured port.
documents.resolution: Stop the stale process and bind the service to a free socket.

documents.title: Java heap exhausted
documents.rootCause: The JVM memory limit is too small for the test suite.
documents.resolution: Inspect heap growth and set a measured memory budget.

documents.title: PostgreSQL connections exhausted
documents.rootCause: The database connection pool has leaked connections.
documents.resolution: Close connections and size the Hikari pool against PostgreSQL limits.

documents.title: EACCES when writing build output
documents.rootCause: The runner lacks permission to write into its working directory.
documents.resolution: Grant the minimum required directory access to the build user.

documents.title: Unexpected HTTP 500 during integration tests
documents.rootCause: The application returns an internal server error.
documents.resolution: Inspect the server error and correct the failing application path.

documents.title: Maven dependency resolution fails
documents.rootCause: The requested artifact is missing from the configured repository.
documents.resolution: Check the dependency coordinates and repository configuration.
